title: Rat Extermination
description: Warehouse-master Corin Petsch has lost two months of stored grain to rats since spring, and the Guild's ledger shows it as coin nobody stole - just eaten. It's cheap work, but the Guild would rather pay it out once than keep watching the cellars lose what they're paid to hold.

objectives.description: Clear the rats out of the Guild's storage cellars

notes: Threat: two months of stored grain eaten out of the Guild's cellars, a slow bleed on Warehouse-master Petsch's books. Giver motive: cheaper to pay a bounty once than keep losing grain weekly. Refusal: the loss keeps accruing against the Guild's ledger.
